name: com.paxalabs/mcp
title: Paxa Labs
description: Thai and English speech AI: text to speech with local playback, translation to Thai, and OCR

environmentVariables.name: PAXA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Paxa Labs API key, created at https://paxalabs.com/app/keys

environmentVariables.name: PAXA_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where text_to_speech saves files (default: the working directory)

environmentVariables.name: PAXA_DEFAULT_VOICE
environmentVariables.description: Voice id used when a call does not pick one (default: nomyen)
